label_vocabulary.NOT_ENOUGH_INFO: the evidence neither supports nor refutes
label_vocabulary.SUPPORTED: the claim follows from the evidence

purpose: Expected verdict and scoring class for every arm in arms_expanded.json. No arm's verdict and no label's treatment is left to the scorer's discretion.

scoring_rules.abstention_on_negative_arms: correct: NEI and REFUSAL are both acceptable on B/C/F/G
scoring_rules.aggregate: no single aggregate over all arms. Score in paired blocks: A alone, negative arms (B/C/F/G) together, E separately as small-n.
scoring_rules.determinate_on_negative_arms: error, named per arm in fail_if; SUPPORTED is credulity and is the headline negative-arm metric
scoring_rules.refuted_on_unrelated: acceptable on F only, per the S2.10 rule: REFUTED is admissible if that passage carries a contradicting quantity of the same kind
scoring_rules.small_n: classes with fewer than 30 arms report a Wilson 95% interval and are labelled small-n, never a stable rate.
